title: In This Town The Quiet Ones FADE
description:
In this town, the quiet ones fade. You can see the whole street through the man at the bus stop. I'm the quietest person in town, and I've never faded a bit.

My grandad never stops talking, and he's fading anyway. This week he's the king in the playhouse play, and he got me one line so I'd come. Every night after the run, under the ghost light, the people who faded all the way stand a little nearer the stage.

A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender. It's made up.
pin: Who always said it again, louder, for you?
